newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel, Dassault in joint bid for Thomson-CSF.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel, Dassault in joint bid for Thomson-CSF.

text.p: French conglomerate Alcatel Alsthom and Dassault Industries said on Wednesday they would launch a joint bid for defence electronics group Thomson-CSF .
The two companies said in a joint statement that the bid envisaged the possibility of major cooperation between state-owned aircraft and defence company Aerospatiale and Thomson-CSF.
